detail: 7/7 acceptance cells; probe PCC 0.999998 on [1,1,32,64] DRAM and [1,4,16,400] L1

what: A compute kernel binding a Float32 DFB with enable_32_bit_dest=True fails host validation (hardware_config.cpp:193) unless ComputeHardwareConfig.unpack_modes names the ring; the examples only use bf16 rings so this is never shown
suggest: Note in the examples README / target page: every FP32 ring a compute kernel consumes under 32-bit DEST needs unpack_modes={name: E.UnpackMode.UnpackToSrc or UnpackToDest}

ref: .claude/references/targets/quasar.md (Ring protocols: run the op once after another program)
what: The page asks for a test with the op after another program but names no tt-metal program that runs on Quasar; the design picked ttnn.add, which is Metal 1 and TT_FATALs on Quasar
suggest: Name a Quasar-runnable predecessor, e.g. a device-side ttnn.to_layout(row_major_tensor, TILE_LAYOUT) tilize

what: On the compute side DataflowBuffer is a class template, so a helper function taking DataflowBuffer& fails to compile; the examples keep everything in kernel_main and never show this
suggest: One line in the examples README: pass rings to helper functions as template parameters (template <typename Ring> void f(Ring&))
